first.rationale: A targeted promotional-pricing experiment directly addresses the competitor-driven loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and is supported by prior acquisition and revenue lift. Verify both the pricing result and onboarding evidence before commitment because activation and completion declines may constrain the realized value of newly acquired accounts; restrict the offer to price-sensitive SMBs and evaluate qualified revenue and retention, not conversions alone.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. Verified evidence showed completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%, directly addressing the current 4% decline in onboarding completion while supporting sustainable account value. The verified pricing result produced a 12% retention decline and should not be used for the long-term qualified-revenue objective. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation to ensure leading-metric gains translate to durable value.
